pipeline.description:
Which {@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline}s to train as a part of {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.TrainingJob}.
At least one of {@link #pipeline} and {@link #template} must be specified.
The {@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline} should be upserted before passing to the training run.
The job will fail immediately if the pipeline is not upserted.

modelName.description:
Names to be used for the newly trained model corresponding to the provided {@link #pipeline}.
Empty string or null value for a specific entry will lead to that model being unnamed.

template.description:
Utilize the {@link ModelTemplate} as {@link ReliabilityMlModel#template} when generating a new model.
If specified, it will override the given {@link #pipeline}.
If the value is null, no {@link ModelTemplate} was applied to the created model.

hyperparamOverrides.description:
Set the hyperparameters passed into either {@link #pipeline}, or the pipeline created from the
{@link #template}.

title:
Specifies the configuration for model creation within a {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.TrainingJob}.
This type defines how models are trained using pipelines and templates, including naming conventions
and hyperparameter settings.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.TrainingJob.ModelCreationSpec
